description: This Java source file defines the DevOpsRoute class which constructs HTTP routes for the /devops endpoint in an Eclipse Ditto-based gateway service. It manages routes for logging configuration, piggyback commands, and configuration retrieval, utilizing Akka HTTP routing and integration with various DevOps commands and configurations.

classes.name: DevOpsRoute
classes.description: Final class that builds Akka HTTP routes for /devops, handling logging, piggyback, and config endpoints with authentication and route composition logic.

methods.name: buildDevOpsRoute
methods.description: Constructs the /devops route handling subroutes for logging, piggyback, and config, with authentication.

methods.name: buildRouteWithOptionalServiceNameAndInstance
methods.description: Builds routes with optional service name and instance parameters.

methods.description: Builds routes with service name and optional instance, parsing URL segments.

methods.name: buildRouteWithServiceNameAndInstance
methods.description: Builds route with specific service name and instance for handling requests.

methods.name: routeLogging
methods.description: Handles GET and PUT requests for logger configuration.

methods.description: Handles POST requests for piggyback commands.

methods.name: routeConfig
methods.description: Handles GET requests for configuration retrieval.

methods.description: Creates a JsonValue transformer to extract parts of JSON responses based on serviceName and instance.
